batch1_dialogue.npc_voice: Culture and rank first (register and forms of address do most of the work; each culture its own grammar)
batch1_dialogue.subtext: By culture (Moto and court voices speak in layers; soldiers and commons speak bluntly)
batch1_dialogue.exposition: Through a character's pride (an NPC who loves their subject over-explains in their own voice)
batch1_dialogue.crowd_talk: Scale to the scene (council cross-talk, tavern murmur, hearing one voice at a time)

batch2_emotion.emotion: Anime-big, said and shown (open, loud, theatrical feeling: tears, shouting)
batch2_emotion.bonds: All four: rival to reluctant ally; mentor and student; found crew; slow-burn romance
batch2_emotion.grief: Full weight, given room (the scene stays with the loss; interior, memory, small physical things)
batch2_emotion.warmth: Big shared celebration (a feast, a festival; color, noise, singing, bodies pressed together)

batch3_villains_stakes.villain_danger: It depends on the villain (no default)
batch3_villains_stakes.villain_entrance: It depends on the villain (no default)
batch3_villains_stakes.stakes: Mixed, by arc (tournament arcs personal, war arcs world-scale)
batch3_villains_stakes.villain_fate: By the character (each villain's end follows their nature and the arc)

batch4_scenes.training: Full scenes with a teacher (a specific exercise, a body in pain, a lesson that costs)
batch4_scenes.settings: Through the POV's eye and body (a place seen by someone with a trade and a mood)
batch4_scenes.mystery: Fair clues, planted early (everything the solution needs is on the page first)
batch4_scenes.time_joins: A bridge paragraph (one developed paragraph carries the days between, with specifics)

batch5_rp_table.consequences: Mixed by weight (a bribe noticed that night, a theft billed within the week, a betrayal waits an arc)
batch5_rp_table.initiative: At natural pauses (hooks come when the PC has a breath; active scenes stay clean)
batch5_rp_table.offstage: Mixed (signs by default, cutaways at turns; the reader sometimes knows more than the PC)
batch5_rp_table.turn_mix: Balanced, steered by the beat (a fight leans on action, a talk on people, a quiet one on interior)

batch6_creatures_humour.creatures: Biology first, like a field naturalist (anatomy, behavior, habitat; believed before feared)
batch6_creatures_humour.humor: All four: dry and deadpan; crude and bawdy; anime gags and reactions; dark and gallows
batch6_creatures_humour.openings: By the scene's weight (fights open in motion, quiet scenes in a place, court scenes on a gesture)
batch6_creatures_humour.interior_flashbacks: Flashbacks sparingly, as big set pieces (interior stays light; big flashbacks are their own marked scenes). FLAG: narrows R79-4 'flashbacks run freely' and 'interiority woven steadily'

batch7_arcs_politics_gear.tournament: Mixed, by the arc (a festival one, a deadly one, a political one)
batch7_arcs_politics_gear.factions: Layered, all three (named wanters, procedures, street consequences)
batch7_arcs_politics_gear.gear: Mixed (wear by default; tier and price when the POV would see them; provenance for famous pieces)
batch7_arcs_politics_gear.romance_short_of_explicit: By character (a shy character quiet, a bold one loud; the card decides how they look at someone)

batch8_voice_endings.narrator: By the POV's culture (a Moto scene narrates in seasons, a Kharven one in prices)
batch8_voice_endings.endings: By the arc's weight (a scene ends on an image, a chapter on a turn, an arc on a door opening)
batch8_voice_endings.pc_inner_life: Bold, give him depth (a memory he has not mentioned may surface; his rewrite overrules). FLAG: conflicts with NATALIE canon hierarchy 'What his PC knows comes from his card and canon, never a new memory'
batch8_voice_endings.motifs: Light callbacks to earlier scenes (a name, a scar, a phrase; the world remembers)

batch9_progression.breakthrough: By the Stage and the story (crisis at Stage IV, a long cell at VII, the sky itself at XII)
batch9_progression.readout: In prose only (no block; the change is described, not tabulated)
batch9_progression.release: Scaled to the stakes (a release that decides a life gets a page; a flourish gets a line)
batch9_progression.overreach: By the Wellspring's failure mode (each fails in its own named way)

batch10_world.battles: By the battle's nature (a siege as vignettes at walls and gates, a field battle as the lead's duel, a massacre wide and cold)
batch10_world.religion: Mixed by culture (the Moto speak to their dead, the Dawi tally them, the Kharven price them)
batch10_world.daily_life: Constantly, as texture (prices, meals, rent, tools, chores in every scene)
batch10_world.slang: Heavily, per culture (each culture's oaths, proverbs and idioms part of every voice)

batch11_length_loop_research.reply_length: As long as the beat needs, no number (drop the 3,500 target everywhere, not only for fights; reverses R79-1 length)
batch11_length_loop_research.auto_research: All four: wounds and injuries; how a working works; crafts, trades and materials; history and period detail
batch11_length_loop_research.multiplayer: By the scene's pace (talk free; a fight ordered with a reply window)

batch12_documents_dreams_names.documents: Used as texture, rarely central (signage and labels carry flavor, not plot)
batch12_documents_dreams_names.dreams: Vivid and concrete, no fog (a dream is a place with objects and rules, specific and strange)
batch12_documents_dreams_names.material_culture: Mixed (specific in most scenes, lingered on in quiet ones, a class and culture signal when it matters)
batch12_documents_dreams_names.names: Comic names among commons, thinning above (major NPCs and carded Moto never; villains and rivals may)

batch13_set_pieces.chases: By the chase (a foot chase, a cart chase and a flight over the mains each take their own shape)
batch13_set_pieces.stealth: Mixed by tone (a clever heist is procedure, a frightened sneak is sensory, a desperate one improvised)
batch13_set_pieces.hunts: By the creature (a rat-swarm is a siege, a drake a duel, a guardian a trial)
batch13_set_pieces.survival: Compressed, with set-piece stops (travel is a bridge paragraph; only encounters get scenes)

batch14_tropes.tropes_in: All four: earned comebacks; rival who turns ally; tournament and training arcs; villain with a sympathetic wound
batch14_tropes.tropes_careful: All four: power of friendship as a free win; last-second power-up from nowhere; easy resurrection; villain monologue that stalls the fight
batch14_tropes.fanservice: Open and adult, when it fits (plain adult physicality in the voice of the story, in scenes that earn it)
batch14_tropes.power_scale: All three (stats decide out of sight and show as tells; upsets possible with a read or vow; characters discuss strength openly)

batch15_machines_healing_children_ooc.machines: All of these (brass and hum for the look, the operator's hands for the feel, a failure for the plot)
batch15_machines_healing_children_ooc.healing: Layered (clinical truth first, slow costly recovery, a magical option only if someone pays)
batch15_machines_healing_children_ooc.children: By the card (each child a person with a want and a refusal; the card sets the register)
batch15_machines_healing_children_ooc.ooc_voice: Adapted to your mood (brisk when you are, playful when you are, careful when you are annoyed)
